rachel: Quick request from Meridianvendor intake: short DPA clause + a 15min presigned PUT code example. Also they want to confirm if any subprocessors access raw uploads directly.
diego: Short answers: presigned URLs default 1h, can do 15m. Not single-use by default. No subprocessors have direct object-store access. Embeddings are encrypted with Redwood-managed keys in hosted; BYOK for private.
anya: Draft paragraph below and I can attach SOC2 cover page under NDA. Also provide a checklist to vendor intake team.
legal: Please avoid ARNs in the public note. Keep key wording general.
sec-bot: Evidence uploaded at /datarooms/meridian/soc2-coverpage.pdf
rachel: Thanks team  I'll send the DPA clause and code snippet and ask if they want a deeper tech appendix.
